screenshots.label: Sunnyside in split screen: two skaters work the concrete park, the deep blue bowl and the long teal quarter pipe behind them, a combo building up at the bottom
Big Sky: the mega ramp's 14 metre roll in, the kicker and the landing slope, a skater flying the gap
Civic Plaza: granite ledges, the terrace with its six-stair sets and handrails, planters and palms
Rooftops: roofs stepping down over the street, parapets and rails to grind, a gap to ollie between the buildings
